model: seeded ridge graph and two independent axis routes
input: common 257^3 M7 scalar plus supplied seed and common seed tangent
split: Algorithm written before any development or test scores were examined. Threshold selected by the root evaluator on development only.
acceptance: Every graph node carries continuous quality in [0,1]; mask valid & quality >= q. Two-route comparator qualifies mutually agreeing orthogonal ridges within two 9.6um voxels.
chart: 2 native 9.6um voxels per knot, +/-96 in the two lateral axes, +/-111 voxels depth, nearest positive ridge within 6 voxels of seed
heldout_policy: No evaluation meshes or labels enter this program.
